title: 第11章 月儿的秘密第12章 迟到的系统
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
黄夜刚准备发动突袭，拿下这个小妞。
月儿高高举起的匕首，却迟迟未落。
这让他有点懵，妹子，你耍大哥玩呢？
到底杀不杀，给个痛快好么？
哥这小心脏真心受不了，如果不是为了隐藏身份，哥早把你叉叉了！
小姑娘的眼泪再次啪嗒啪嗒落下来，随之，手臂软软地垂下来。
她也不知道怎么回事儿，第一次准备很充分，也勇敢地下手了，结果这家伙竟然神奇地躲过去了。
第二次因为顾虑重重，放弃了刺杀。到了这次，自己竟然无法挥出匕首了。
其实不怪月儿下不去手，这就像打仗一样，“一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。”
她现在的士气远没有第一次勇敢，毕竟只是个女孩，年纪也不大，杀人经验为零。
黄夜看她放下匕首，一颗悬着的心总算落下。
来到这个世界才几天，得到的信息太少。
月儿很容易制住，可是不论杀了她，还是撵走她，都会暴露自己。
第一次原主被人敲了闷棍，侥幸死里逃生，第二次对方绝不会留手。
府里能让他万劫不复的人大把抓，而自己只有一个会点三角猫功夫的晴儿。
隐忍才是万全之策，自从知道那些侍卫的实力，给原主报仇的想法现在已经很淡，练习轻功也是为了跑路。
月儿收好匕首，轻轻褪去衣衫，钻进被窝，两人背靠背躺着。
黄夜感觉她虽然没发出声音，但从抖动的双肩判断，这丫头在暗自哭泣。
真是个奇怪的丫头，她的心事很重，这可不是一个杀手该有的心态。
看来她刺杀自己并非本意，里面肯定有一堆故事。

唉！又要度过一个不眠之夜了，万一这丫头再次动了杀心，自己一旦睡着，那就挂了。
有了，既然不能睡，可以练功。
那套轻功也是运气的法门，虽然功法要求盘膝练功，自己可以试试躺着练功。
不就是气运丹田么，只要做到这点就好，于是开始一遍遍尝试。
折腾了大半夜，终于有气感产生，不知这种感悟速度算不算合格。
今后不跟任何人对比了，自己的目标永远定为下一个层次，这样就没有比上不足比下有余的想法。
只有这样，才能不断突破自我，这也符合奥运精神——更高，更快，更强！
继续按照功法练习，他发现气血运转得并不顺利，每次运气到丹田，会自行向腿部移动。
卧槽，练功太特么辛苦，要是有系统该有多好，想啥有啥。
多次尝试后，效果奇差无比，先缓一缓。
身边的月儿早就没了动静，应该是睡着了。
看向月儿的小脸，这妞在这种平和状态下也是个美人，虽然比晴儿差点，但也有85分。
晴儿是鹅蛋脸，月儿是瓜子脸，在现代她们要是开直播，也是网红，比那些靠美颜的网红强了百倍。
还是继续修炼吧，月儿睡着了，自己的动作可以大一些。
这次把身体蜷缩起来，再次运转气血，果然效果好一些。
蜷缩的角度再次加大，效果更好了。
嗯，看来古人盘膝运气的方式确实有科学道理。
规矩是死的，人是活的，未必不能走出一条全新的路，只要肯去摸索就好。
于是他开始尝试，先从蜷缩状态开始，一点点打开身体。
认真感受不同身体状态下的每一丝气流变化。
content_en:
Huang Yegang was about to launch a surprise attack to capture this girl.
The dagger held high by Yue'er has yet to fall.
This made him a little confused. Girl, are you trying to fool me?
Do you want to kill me or not? Can you give me a good time?
My little heart really can't bear it. If it weren't for hiding my identity, I would have killed you long ago!
The little girl's tears fell down again, and then her arms hung down softly.
She didn't know what was going on. She was well prepared for the first time and took action bravely, but this guy miraculously escaped.
The second time, I gave up the assassination because of worries. This time, he couldn't swing the dagger anymore.
In fact, it’s not to blame Yue’er for not taking action. It’s like fighting a war: “One surge of energy will weaken again, and three times it will be exhausted.”
Her current morale is far less brave than the first time. After all, she is just a girl, not very young, and has zero killing experience.
Huang Ye saw her put down the dagger, and her hanging heart finally dropped.
I have only been in this world for a few days and I have received too little information.
Yue'er is easy to control, but whether he kills her or drives her away, he will expose himself.
The first time the original owner was beaten by someone and managed to escape death, but the second time the other party would never hold back.
There are many people in the house who can make him irredeemable, but he only has one Qing'er who can learn the triangle cat kung fu.
Forbearance is the safest strategy. Ever since I learned about the strength of those guards, the thought of revenge for the original owner has faded away. I practice Qinggong just to escape.
Yue'er put away the dagger, gently took off her clothes, got into bed, and the two of them lay back to back.
Huang Ye felt that although she didn't make a sound, judging from her shaking shoulders, the girl was crying secretly.
What a strange girl. She is very worried. This is not the mentality a killer should have.
It seems that she didn't mean to assassinate herself. There must be a lot of stories in it.
well! He was about to spend another sleepless night. If this girl had murderous intentions again, she would die as soon as she fell asleep.
Yes, since I can’t sleep, I can practice Qigong.
That set of Qing Gong is also a method of luck. Although the method requires you to practice cross-legged, you can try doing it while lying down.
Isn't it just luck in the Dantian? As long as it can be done, it will be fine, so I started trying it over and over again.
After struggling for most of the night, I finally felt Qi. I wonder if this speed of realization is considered qualified.
From now on, I will not compare myself with anyone else, and my goal will always be the next level, so there will be no thought of being less than above or more than below.
Only in this way can we continue to break through ourselves, which is also in line with the Olympic spirit - higher, faster, stronger!
Continuing to practice according to the exercises, he found that the qi and blood were not flowing smoothly. Every time luck reached the Dantian, it would move to the legs on its own.
Damn it, practicing is so hard. It would be great if there was a system to do whatever you want.
After several attempts, the effect was extremely poor, so I took it easy for a while.
Yue'er beside her has long since stopped moving, and must have fallen asleep.
Looking at Yue'er's little face, this girl is also a beauty in such a peaceful state. Although she is not as beautiful as Qing'er, she still has 85 points.
Qing'er has an oval face and Yue'er has an oval face. In modern times, if they live broadcast, they will also be Internet celebrities, which is a hundred times better than those Internet celebrities who rely on their beauty.
Let's continue practicing. Yue'er is asleep, so she can move bigger.
This time I curled up my body and circulated my Qi and blood again, and the effect was indeed better.
The angle of curling up is increased again, and the effect is better.
Well, it seems that the way the ancients crossed their legs to bring luck did have a scientific basis.
Rules are dead, but people are alive. You may not be unable to find a new path, as long as you are willing to explore.
So he started to try, starting from the curled up state and opening his body bit by bit.
Carefully feel every change in airflow under different body states.
